description: NASA has begun construction of the Dragonfly mission, which will utilise a nuclear-powered rotorcraft lander to investigate Saturn's largest moon, Titan. The car-sized drone is scheduled to launch in 2028 and will conduct a comprehensive surface survey using its Multi-Mission Radioisotope Thermoelectric Generator (MMRTG). The spacecraft will complete a six-year cruise, arriving at Titan in 2034 to perform detailed exploration activities across the moon's surface.
title: NASA Begins Building Dragonfly Drone; Nuclear-Powered ‘Octocopter’ Enters Testing Ahead of 2028 Launch

description: Kenatha Kanom is a Tamil comedy-drama that tells the story of a village struggling with severe water scarcity. It aims to address the water crisis while revealing a hidden, even larger conspiracy. When the villagers approach the district collector for help, they are met with indifference. According to reports, Kenatha Kanom will be available to watch on JioHotstar soon; the date is not yet confirmed.
title: Kenatha Kanom Locks OTT Platform: When and Where to Watch Yogi Babu’s Rural Satire Online?

description: The Tamil comedy-drama Local Times is a story of friendship, ambition, and the struggle to achieve one's dreams. The series draws on the everyday chaos of small-town journalism, coated with a blend of humour and emotion. Now streaming on OTT in India, the story follows four young friends determined to save their failing newspaper. Local Times Season 1 debuted on March 13, 2026, on Prime Video India.
title: Local Times OTT Release Date: What to Know About This New Malayalam Friendship Comedy

description: Muthu, also known as Kattan, is an upcoming Tamil-language series. description: Vivo T5x 5G is scheduled to be launched in India on March 17 at 12 pm IST. A dedicated microsite for the upcoming smartphone from the Chinese tech firm was recently made live on Flipkart, revealing its availability in the country via the e-commerce platform. The Vivo T series handset is confirmed to go on sale in India in two colour options, dubbed Cyber Green and Star Silver. The Vivo T5x 5G will be powered by a MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset, which is claimed to offer 10 percent and 15 percent improvements in overall and AI performance, respectively.
title: Vivo T5x 5G Roundup: Launch Date, Expected Price in India and Specifications
